topic: The last day of summer camp
brief: For an English-language school choir: English only, no words in other languages.
title: Last Day of Camp
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We packed our bags and rolled our sleeping mats,
we swapped our numbers and we signed our hats,
the lake was still, the fire burning low,
nobody wanted to be the first to go.

[Chorus]
Adiós, amigos, hasta el verano,
nunca olvidaré tu mano,
adiós, amigos, no llores más,
el año que viene volverás.

[Verse 2]
The bus is waiting by the dining hall,
we wave until we can't see them at all,
I've got a friendship bracelet on my wrist,
and every name I'll ever miss.

[Chorus]
Adiós, amigos, hasta el verano,
nunca olvidaré tu mano,
adiós, amigos, no llores más,
el año que viene volverás.
reason: The brief requires English only, but the whole chorus is in Spanish.
